apps.safe-bridge.name: Safe Connect
apps.safe-bridge.summary: Use an existing Safe on another chain as the source of funds. Assets never move. Deliberation and policy run here, the Safe keeps enforcing its own threshold.
apps.moneygram-payout.name: MoneyGram Payout
apps.moneygram-payout.summary: Cash collection in 100+ countries. Employees convert salary without a bank account. Only the aggregate and the recipient reference leave the account.
apps.wise-payout.name: Wise Transfers
apps.wise-payout.summary: Multi currency payout to local bank accounts at interbank rates. Handles the leg between settlement and an employee bank account.
apps.monument-gbp.name: Monument Deposits
apps.monument-gbp.summary: Fund payroll from a UK bank account in tokenised sterling. No stablecoin conversion and no offramp needed, because the asset is already a regulated deposit.
apps.treasury-yield.name: Treasury Yield
apps.treasury-yield.summary: Deploy idle treasury into lending markets without publishing the strategy. Proposes moves inside an allowance you set. It cannot move funds on its own.
apps.xero-sync.name: Xero Sync
apps.xero-sync.summary: Posts settled payroll to your ledger as a single journal entry. Reads totals only, so your accounting integration never holds individual salaries.
apps.quickbooks-sync.name: QuickBooks Sync
apps.quickbooks-sync.summary: Posts settled payroll to your ledger as a single journal entry. Reads totals only, so your accounting integration never holds individual salaries.
apps.hmrc-rti.name: HMRC Real Time Information
apps.hmrc-rti.summary: Files UK payroll submissions from an attestation rather than a spreadsheet of salaries. Issues the proof, submits the return.
apps.auditor-portal.name: Auditor Portal
apps.auditor-portal.summary: Scoped, time boxed access for an external accountant. They verify what they need and see nothing else, and the grant expires on its own.
apps.vesting.name: Vesting and Cap Table
apps.vesting.summary: Scheduled disbursement with shielded amounts on the same engine as payroll. Cliffs are provable without being publicly trackable.
apps.contributor-bounties.name: Contributor Payouts
apps.contributor-bounties.summary: Pay contributors and bounty claimants from the same account, confidentially, without adding them to the payroll roster.

setup.step.signers.line: Invite the people who approve spending, and choose how many of them must approve each payment.
setup.step.signers.soon: Invite co-signers by link or with a code, and choose how many must approve, for example 2 of 3.
setup.step.handOver.name: Hand the company to its signers
setup.step.handOver.line: Until you do, this service holds a temporary key that can change the rules your company's account follows. Handing it over gives that power to your signers alone.

setup.createCompany.nameHint: This service reads the name once, to set up the company. After that it is kept locked, and only you and the people you add can open it.
setup.createCompany.nameFirst: Enter a name to create the company.
setup.createCompany.how: Your account opens on this page and asks you to approve. That lets this page save your access to the company.
setup.createCompany.created: Your company is created, and your keys for it are saved.
setup.createCompany.waitingTitle: A company you created is not finished
setup.createCompany.waitingBody: Its keys are only in this tab, so they are lost if you close it or sign out. Finish saves them with your other keys.
setup.createCompany.finishFirst: Finish the company you created first.
setup.handOver.what: After this, only your signers can change your company's rules. Those rules decide what every vault pays out. Enough of them must sign each change.
setup.handOver.button: Hand the company to its signers
setup.handOver.permanent: You cannot undo this. When a signer joins or leaves, or approvals change, your signers sign a change to match. Until they do, this app pays nothing in or out of your vaults, and a signer who has left can still act, so make the change straight away.
setup.handOver.everySigner: Every signer must approve every payment and every change. If one of them loses their account for good, nobody can pay out the money in your vaults, ever. Set approvals below the number of signers to avoid this.
setup.handOver.signChange: Sign the change in your account
setup.handOver.goSigners: Go to Add signers and set approvals
setup.handOver.confirmHandOver: You approve in your account. This service then hands the company to the signers your company's own records list. You cannot undo this.
setup.handOver.confirmChange: Your account signs the change that brings the company's account and vaults to your signers as they are now. The change is sent once enough of them have signed.
setup.handOver.why.noCompany: Create the company first. There is nothing to hand over yet.
setup.handOver.why.reading: Checking who holds your company's rules.
setup.handOver.why.notOnChain: Your company is still being set up on the network. Check again shortly.
setup.handOver.why.vaultKeysMissing_one: Your company has {count} signer, you. Give your vault keys before it can be handed over.
setup.handOver.why.vaultKeysMissing_othe: All {count} signers give their vault keys before the company can be handed over. Give yours here. The others give theirs on their own devices.
setup.handOver.why.tooFewApprovals_one: Any one of your {count} signers could change the rules on their own. Set approvals to at least 2 first.
setup.handOver.why.tooFewApprovals_other: Any one of your {count} signers could change the rules on their own. Set approvals to at least 2 first.
setup.handOver.why.held: Done. Your signers now hold the company.
setup.handOver.why.changeOwed: Your signers have changed since the company was handed over. Until the signers who hold it now sign a change to match, this app pays nothing in or out of your vaults, and anyone who has left can still act.
setup.handOver.why.waiting: Either the handover is sent and the network has not confirmed it yet, or this site cannot hand companies over. Check again shortly, and if this stays, contact support.
setup.handOver.why.heldByOtherKeys: Your company's account is held by keys that are not your signers'. Nothing here can change that. Contact support.
setup.handOver.why.unreadable: We could not check who holds your company just now. Nothing was sent. Check again shortly.
setup.handOver.why.unreachable: This site's service could not be reached. Nothing was sent.

act.refused.gaveUp: You stopped waiting for your account. Nothing was done.
act.refused.silent: Your account did not answer. Try again.
act.refused.noKeysHere: This company is not set up for your account on this device. Open it on the device where you created or joined it.
act.refused.rosterDisagrees: Your company's own records do not match what this service reports, so nothing was sent. Reload the page, and if it happens again, contact support.
act.refused.nothingToSign: There is nothing for you to sign. The other signers sign the rest.
act.refused.nothingSent: Nothing was sent and nothing was spent. Try again, and if it happens again, contact support.
act.refused.unreachable: This site's service could not be reached, so we cannot tell whether this went through. Reload the page to see where things stand before you try again.
act.refused.didNotFinish: It did not finish. Try again, and if it happens again, contact support.
act.refused.noSeat: Your seat on this company is not on the company's records this device opened, so your records key was not signed and your vault keys were not given. Reload the page; if it happens again, contact support.

setup.handOver.done.handOver: Sent. Your signers hold the company once the network confirms it. Check again in a minute.
setup.handOver.done.signChange: Your signature is in. The change is sent once enough signers have signed.

createVault.what: A vault is built on this device, sent to the network, and handed to your signers as soon as the network has it. Until your signers hold it and it is set up, this app puts no money into it.
createVault.why.noCompany: Create your company first. A vault belongs to a company.
createVault.why.reading: Checking whether a vault can be created…
createVault.why.yoursMissing: Give your vault keys first. A vault is created only once every signer has given theirs.
createVault.why.othersMissing: Not every signer has given their vault keys yet. A vault can be created once they all have, each from their own account.
createVault.why.rosterDisagrees: Your company's own records do not match the signers' keys this service reports, so no vault can be created. Reload the page, and if it happens again, contact support.
createVault.why.notOnChain: Your company is still being set up on the network. Check again in a few minutes.
createVault.why.locked: Your keys are not open on this page yet. Open them with your account to check whether a vault can be created.
createVault.confirm: You approve in your account. The vault is then built on this device, which can take a few minutes, sent to the network, and handed to your signers. This service pays the network fee. A vault cannot be removed once it is sent. Keep this page open until it is done.
createVault.confirmFinish: You approve in your account. The vault is then handed to your signers from this device. Keep this page open until it is done.
createVault.stage.building: Building the vault on this device. This can take a few minutes…
createVault.stage.sending: Sending the vault to the network…
createVault.stage.waitingForChain: Waiting for the network to confirm the vault…
createVault.stage.handingOver: Handing the vault to your signers…
createVault.stage.waitingForHandover: Waiting for the network to confirm your signers hold it…
createVault.stage.adopting: Adding the vault to your company's account…
createVault.stage.openingThePool: Setting up the vault's private records on this device…
createVault.stage.readingTheSecretBack: Checking the vault's secret was saved…
createVault.stage.settingTheSecret: Setting the vault's secret on the network…
createVault.stage.writingTheCopies: Saving a sealed copy of the vault's secret for each signer…
createVault.stage.waitingForApprovals: Waiting for your other signers to approve…
createVault.done: The vault is created and set up, and your signers hold it.
createVault.done.notHandedOver: This app puts money into a vault only once your company is handed to its signers.
createVault.owed.title: Vault {number} is not finished
createVault.owed.body: It was sent, and your signers do not hold it yet, so this app puts no money into it. Finish handing it over from this device.
createVault.owed.now: The vault was sent, and your signers do not hold it yet, so this app puts no money into it. Finish handing it over from this device.
createVault.owed.elsewhere: The vault was sent, and your signers do not hold it yet. Only the device it was created on can finish handing it over. This app has put no money into it. If that device is gone, create a new vault and send nothing to this one.
createVault.owed.notHere: It was sent, and your signers do not hold it yet, so this app puts no money into it. Only the device it was created on can finish handing it over. If that device is gone, create a new vault and send nothing to this one.
createVault.owed.rosterDisagrees: The vault was sent, and the signers this service reports for it are not the ones your company's own records name, so it is not handed over from here and this app puts no money into it. Contact support.
createVault.awaiting.adoption: Your signers hold the vault, but it cannot take money yet. Adding it to your company needs {needed} approvals and has {approvals}. Each of your other signers approves it from their own device: they open this vault and press Finish setting it up. This app puts no money into it until it has them all.
createVault.awaiting.firstSecret: The vault is added to your company, but it cannot take money yet. Its set-up needs {needed} approvals and has {approvals}. Each of your other signers approves it from their own device: they open this vault and press Finish setting it up, and their device first checks that every signer can open the vault's secret with their own recovery words. This app puts no money into it until it has them all.
createVault.startOwed: Setting up the vault did not finish. It cannot take money yet, and this app puts none into it. Finish setting it up.
createVault.stopped.wallet: Setting up the vault stopped before anything was approved: your wallet has not read who holds your company on the network since it last changed. Open your company with your wallet again, then finish setting it up. This app puts no money into the vault until it is set up.
createVault.stopped.handOver: Setting up the vault stopped before anything was approved: your company is not yet held by its signers on the network, so who the vault's secret is sealed to cannot be checked. Hand your company to its signers, then open it with your wallet again and finish setting it up. This app puts no money into the vault until then.
createVault.stopped.signers: Setting up the vault stopped before anything was approved: not every signer is set up for vaults as your signers stand now. Each signer opens your company's vaults on their own device once, and your signers' keys on the network are brought up to date, then finish setting it up. This app puts no money into the vault until then.
createVault.stopped.mismatch: Setting up the vault stopped before anything was approved: the people its secret would be sealed to are not exactly your signers, each with a key their own wallet signed. Nothing was approved and no money moved. Reload the page; if it happens again, contact support.
createVault.stopped.vault: Setting up the vault stopped before anything was approved: the vault is not held by your signers as they stand now on the network. If it is not handed over yet, only the device it was created on can finish that. If your signers have changed since, sign the change that brings it up to date. Then finish setting it up. This app puts no money into the vault until then.
createVault.goHandOver: Go to Hand the company to its signers
createVault.confirmStart: You approve in your account. Setting up the vault then carries on from this device, from where it stopped. Keep this page open until it is done.
